name: zcode-tps
description: Token 速率与用量监控:每轮回复末尾显示最近轮均速率、Decode 会话均、会话累计 token 与缓存命中率(读取 ZCode usage 数据库);/tps 报表另含请求级明细、Decode 分布与辅助请求用量,/tps-doctor 自检。

description_i18n.en: Token rate & usage monitor: appends latest-turn tok/s, session-weighted Decode, session tokens and cache hit rate to each reply (from ZCode usage DB); /tps report with request-level detail, decode distribution and auxiliary usage; /tps-doctor included.
